title: Key split across lines by a shell line continuation
summary: A backslash and a line feed inside an unquoted assignment value split the key; the shell removes both.
rationale: The surrounding language rebuilds the original value, so the value the program sees is the intact key.

expectation.rationale: Project policy of this example: a mechanism that reconstructs the original value keeps the credential; coverage is every fragment.

notes: Worked example for the representation guide (ADR 0016). Synthetic; the policy stated here is an example, not a claim about any product.
